report.summary: Patient P-D008 (age 41, Medicaid with transport benefit, home tract 17031400800) screens positive for utilities shutoff risk and reports no transportation. Tract is low-income with 45.7% of households lacking a vehicle and 41.5% of residents reporting utility shutoff — both needs are elevated in the neighborhood. Recommended: (Utilities) Lakeside Energy Assistance, open eligibility, likely to qualify; Shutoff Prevention Clinic walk-in Tuesdays for disconnection notices; Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based, apply in person Mon/Wed). (Transport) Medicaid Ride Line via the number on the member card, scheduled at least 2 business days ahead; Paratransit Info Desk for ADA certification (up to 21 days for decision). Senior Shuttle is not applicable (patient is under 60). Next appointment is 2026-10-22 at 16:00 (primary care) — arrange Ride Line well in advance; facility location not on file, so a transit feasibility check could not be completed.
